test_title: SSC CGL 2024 Tier-I Official Paper (Held On: 13 Sept, 2024 Shift 3)
subject: general
question:
Select the option that can be used as a one-word substitute for the given group of words.

One who speaks less in a forum.
solution:
The correct answer is 'Option 4'.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word "**reticent**" refers to someone who is reserved, introverted, or speaks less in a forum or in public settings. (संकोची)

 
 
• **Example:** He was reticent about discussing his personal life in front of strangers.
 
 

Hence, the correct answer is '**Option 4**'.

**Correct Sentence***: She was a reticent speaker who preferred to observe rather than engage in discussions.*

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Option 1: "Eccentric"** (अजीब) refers to someone who behaves in unusual or odd ways, not related to speaking less.

 
 
• **Example:** The eccentric artist wore mismatched clothes every day.
 
 
 
• **Option 2: "Loquacious"** (बातूनी) means talkative, which is the opposite of speaking less.
 
 
• **Example:** She was so loquacious that she dominated every conversation.
 
 
 
• **Option 3: "Gabby"** (बातूनी) also means talkative or overly chatty, which again does not fit the context.
 
 
• **Example:** The gabby student never stopped talking during class.
